cohort: The study included 2722 preterm infants categorized by gestational age into <=28 weeks, 28+1 to 33+6 weeks, and 34-37 weeks.
finding: Low Prognostic Nutritional Index (PNI) level is associated with an increased risk of Neonatal Respiratory Distress Syndrome (NRDS) in preterm infants across all different gestational ages.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with an increased risk of NRDS in infants born at 34-37 weeks gestational age.
birth_weight: N/A (birth weight was collected as a variable but no specific range for the cohort was mentioned)
gest_age: Preterm infants, categorized into <=28 weeks, 28+1 to 33+6 weeks, and 34-37 weeks gestational age.
